summary: Adapter is stateless and requires hidden_state=false, forbids shell commands, validates declared slice and nonempty contract/validator hashes; prepare requires strict Skill input gate and records binding/context hashes; lifecycle is prepared -> red-observed -> green-observed -> refactor-verified, with RED requiring declared failing exit and test/docs-only paths, GREEN requiring success and production paths, REFACTOR requiring success within production/tests/docs; unknown or invalid transitions block with RMAP diagnostics; finalize yields non-authoritative implementation-candidate only after exact red/green/refactor sequence; resume rejects stale identities and failed/stale/superseded runs; stage bindings require capsule-attempt bundle v1, exactly one context/attempt per stage, matching IDs/hashes, empty authorizations; protocol persistence validates artifact keys, path containment, no reparse points, immutable existing evidence, declared ordered documents and observation exceptions; execute rejects existing run directories, requires protocol bundle/store paired, persists recovery-state v1 with hashes, lineage nulls, stages, empty authorizations; adapter never authorizes acceptance, handoff, or release.
